W.note: The hover morphs the violet pill into a rose-magenta glow with a sheen sweep and a letter-spacing lift, using four named curves at 520 to 1400ms, though the frosted glass buttons add backdrop-filter cost.

X.note: The most practical build, with keyboard parity, touch gating and a full reduced-motion fallback, but the hover is a restrained lift and faint glow that reads more as polite than dreamlike, and the lab panel adds clutter.

Y.note: The cream button on navy gets a float curve with a tiny return, a fading rim and a lingering glow, all on transform and opacity, though the hover capture hit a disabled button so the hero response is not visible in the frames.

Z.note: The moodboard page is the most polished layout and the ink button gets a breathing aura and sheen sweep, but the glossy band reads more like a sheen than ethereal light and the looping blurred pseudo-element is costly on every save button.
